query: What is Duolingo's most recently reported number of monthly active users, and its most recently reported number of full-time employees? Give each figure with its reporting period and the primary source.
report: Duolingo’s most recently reported monthly active users (MAUs) were 153.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, reported in its Q3 2026 shareholder letter/quarterly results materials [1]. Duolingo’s most recently reported full-time employee count was “more than 900” employees as of December 31, 2025, reported in its Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 (filed February 27, 2026) [2].
